title: Lunar Drifter
description:
Lunar Drifter is an arcade first person shooter heavily inspired by The Mercenaries minigame from the Resident Evil series. Tear apart the highest amount of enemies possible while running and gunning to keep yourself alive, while finding clocks and hourglasses to give yourself precious extra seconds and make the most of your limited time.

Be the ultimate legion killer. Aim precisely, move fast, heal up, and do not let the combo break!

 

 

As you progress through the chaos, more dangerous it will be, the enemies will get all kinds of backup varying from infantry, choppers, tanks, and even the undead itself.

Each of the 4 playable characters have their own unique play style. Engage at long range with snipers, run and gun with pistols and smgs, or face the enemy in close quarters with sledgehammers and shotguns.

You'll get to choose your own route in the main Arcade Mode. DANGER LEVEL will get carried over between Scenarios in your journey and even between different runs!

There is plenty of dangerous surprises waiting...

Yes! Play alongside with friends in Co-Op mode or against them in Deathmatch mode!

• 4 different Playable Characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal.

• +15 unique hand-crafted levels, from Greek Temples, Cities, Moroccan castles, to the Moon.

• An Ever-Escalating Arcade mode with the possibility of multiple New Game+ unleashing even more chaos

• Free Play! Play the Scenarios you unlocked and compete on the Leaderboards with the best of the best or challenge your friends' scores.

• Endless Mode! Deep dive into a marathon of madness!

• Loadout customization, offering different weapons and variants.

• Online Co-Op up to 8 players and Difficulty Modifiers, experience the chaos fitted for friends!

• Online Deathmatch up to 8 players, get to explode your besties!

• Lots of Customization Options, including crosshairs, viewmodel positioning, third person view.

• Full Controller Support with aim assist and input rebindings.

• And much more!

Good luck! 

See you at the leaderboards!
description_short: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 15 unique hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!
